title: "Customer Support Ticket Analysis"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
---

```{r}
# Load the skimr package for data quality and exploratory data analysis
library(skimr) 
```


```{r}
# Read the cleaned data file
data <- read.csv("Customer_support_data_cleaned.csv")
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Generate a comprehensive overview of the dataset, including data types,
# missing values, summary statistics, and value distributions
skim(data)
```
```{r}
# Count the number of missing values in each column
colSums(is.na(data))
```
```{r}
# Count the number of duplicate rows in the dataset
sum(duplicated(data))
```
```{r}
# Count the number of negative response times
sum(data$response_time_minutes < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Display summary statistics for each variable, including minimum, maximum,
# quartiles, mean (numeric), and frequency counts (categorical)
summary(data)
```
